flashcard_questions.q: What does sexual stereotyping mean in everyday life?
flashcard_questions.a: Having a fixed general idea of how men and women will behave.

flashcard_questions.q: What does “ordained” mean in a Christian church?
flashcard_questions.a: Made a priest or minister through a formal ceremony.

flashcard_questions.q: What is gender prejudice, as distinct from discrimination?
flashcard_questions.a: Holding biased opinions about someone based on their gender, before the facts are known.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Act first made gender discrimination illegal in the UK?
Which law replaced the Sex Discrimination Act?
How much more likely are Muslim women in Britain to be unemployed?
flashcard_questions.a: 71% more likely than white Christian women with the same education.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Bible verse says God created humankind male and female in his image?
Which Bible verse says there is neither male nor female in Christ Jesus?
What does Ephesians 5:22–23 say about husbands?
flashcard_questions.a: The husband is the head of the wife, as Christ is head of the church.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Bible story shows Jesus treating women as capable of more than housework?
flashcard_questions.a: The story of Mary and Martha.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Qur’an verse says all people were created from a single man and woman?
What did Muhammad command about the treatment of women?
flashcard_questions.a: I command you to be kind to women.

flashcard_questions.q: What property rights does Islamic law give a married woman?
flashcard_questions.a: She keeps full property rights before and after marriage.

flashcard_questions.q: Why do Muslims say women lack full rights in some Muslim countries?
flashcard_questions.a: They blame local cultural practice rather than the teachings of the Qur’an.

flashcard_questions.q: Why do many Christians say traditional teaching on gender roles is out of date?
flashcard_questions.a: It reflects the position of women when the Bible was written, not God’s will today.

notes: 15 cards: 4 term→definition (sexual stereotyping, ordained, gender prejudice, Equality Act), 4 belief→source (Genesis 1:27, Galatians 3:28, Ephesians 5:22–23, Qur’an 49:13), 2 statistic/legal facts (Sex Discrimination Act 1975, 71% unemployment gap), 3 tradition→position (Mary and Martha, Muhammad on women, Islamic property rights), 2 argument→view (cultural practice, out-of-date teaching).
